heading: 20. INT. PRECINCT, HOMICIDE SQUAD ROOM — DAY

lines.speaker: BRENNAN
lines.script_text: "The Night Judge." They gave him a name, Elias. You know what happens when they give them a name. (beat) Everyone you name ends up in a body bag.
lines.text: "The Night Judge." They gave him a name, Elias. You know what happens when they give them a name. Everyone you name ends up in a body bag.

lines.speaker: BRENNAN
lines.script_text: Your board was in your apartment. Who's been in your apartment?
lines.text: Your board was in your apartment. Who's been in your apartment?

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.script_text: Nobody. Walt, the super. Adler, once.
lines.text: Nobody. Walt, the super. Adler, once.

lines.speaker: BRENNAN
lines.script_text: Then find out who's listening. (beat) And the next name you give me gets a uniform on their door. I'm not losing a fourth.
lines.text: Then find out who's listening. And the next name you give me gets a uniform on their door. I'm not losing a fourth.
